description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for git pull options and behaviors. It sets up various git repositories and verifies different pull command flags and their effects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a string in output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a ref does not exist.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a git commit with specified message.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets a hook script (like commit-msg) in a repo.
